elements_not_encoded.text: Manage and refer urgently for gynaecological/surgical assessment:
If BP < 90/60, give sodium chloride 0.9% 500mL IV rapidly, repeat until systolic BP > 90. Continue 1L 6 hourly. Stop if breathing worsens.
Give ceftriaxone2 1g IV (avoid diluting with lidocaine 1%) and metronidazole3 400mg orally.
For pain, give ibuprofen4 400mg 8 hourly with/after food.
